scripts.build: pnpm --filter @jiweiyuan/runbrowser-server build && pnpm --filter @jiweiyuan/runbrowser-core build && pnpm --filter @jiweiyuan/runbrowser-mcp --filter @jiweiyuan/runbrowser build
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:extension
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @jiweiyuan/runbrowser-core typecheck && pnpm --filter @jiweiyuan/runbrowser-mcp typecheck && pnpm --filter @jiweiyuan/runbrowser typecheck
scripts.publish:all: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @jiweiyuan/runbrowser-server publish --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @jiweiyuan/runbrowser-core publish --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @jiweiyuan/runbrowser-mcp publish --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @jiweiyuan/runbrowser publish --no-git-checks
